entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Our prior theme, love... It proved to be[n]quite useful for me indeed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: After our enlightening session, I once[n]again attempted to paint.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, nothing I put on the canvas[n]was to my satisfaction...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Before the gods of art, I am naught[n]but a lost sheep...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah yes, lost sheep! I have come here[n]with you for precisely that reason.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Our theme today shall be anguish!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I shall paint the anguish Christ felt as he[n]bore the sins of mankind!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, I have seen various sculptures and[n]paintings on the matter... but merely[n]replicating them will not do.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Would any believers be willing[n]to model and help me capture[n]the true essence of anguish?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems not...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well. [fName], you will[n]have to be my model today.
Make me beautiful.
I dunno if I can do it...
Do you want me to strip?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can only represent the reality of my[n]base subject. Anything more would be[n]asking too much.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You needn't be nervous. My eyes see[n]potential within you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You are like a diamond in the rough.[n]Apply a little polish, and you too will[n]shine in time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Yes, that must be it! That is what I need!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Only a subject naked as the day they[n]were born can convey the true anguish[n]of birth!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now then... strip!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Take it all—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Actually, perhaps not. Being found stark-[n]naked in a church would be even bigger[n]news than the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now then, let us begin. Show me a pose[n]that will put the anguish of Christ[n]on full display.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, I see...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So this would be...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No, perhaps...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems this is not working.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I would like to capture anguish, yet you[n]remain calm and composed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even the slightest wrinkle can change[n]one's impression of things... I shall not[n]compromise, even for this sketch!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now, raise your hands higher!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: More... Give me more anguish![n]Bring it to its upper limits!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Like this!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hrm, this position... So this is the Passion[n]of the Christ!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Forsaken by his disciples, abhorred as[n]a criminal by the public, pierced with[n]nails and hung on the cross...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I understand now... This is the true[n]anguish of the Passion!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It feels as though something is boiling up[n]within me!

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Wh-What are you children doing!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is an art study...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Art? ...That?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I am attempting to paint anguish, so[n]I decided to use the crucifixion of Christ[n]as a point of reference...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: So you're interested in the anguish of[n]the crucifixion?

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Hmmm. While it is true that Jesus'[n]crucifixion on the cross is a symbol[n]of deep suffering...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: It also bears a much more positive[n]message... One of resurrection,[n]of forgiveness.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Resurrection? Forgiveness?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm not sure I understand... Those ideas[n]are contradictory to my conception[n]of anguish...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: It may be difficult to grasp what[n]I'm saying right now...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: But try to consider that the anguish one[n]may feel today will someday bring forth[n]new hope.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Ah, and by the way... I suggest you[n]contain your excitement while here.[n]You may trouble the congregation.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So those shocking depictions were[n]actually meant to represent forgiveness,[n]not pain...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, hope from anguish...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'm not sure I understand.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must learn more about the hearts[n]of men...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]... Do you think I will be able[n]to capture the truth someday?
I'm sure you will.[clr 27]
It doesn't look like it.[clr 27]
Do you want to give up?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Indeed. If I do not have belief in my[n]own abilities, I will never come to[n]accomplish anything.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmph... That doubt only serves to[n]push me onward towards my goal.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Was that provocation intentional?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Is that how it seems?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You clearly do not know me quite well[n]enough yet.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is exceedingly strange though.[n]Spending time with you has helped me[n]discover new aspects of myself...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You are perhaps... a mirror of sorts.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If there is anything I can do in return,[n]please let me know... I wish to repay[n]your kindness.
I feel like my bond with Yusuke[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us return home for today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I bid you farewell.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Farewell.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wonderful.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Goodbye, [fName].
